verdictStatement: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. CLAUDE-DALJ-V3-B1 is landed by a material remake rather than a relabel: recordedInputs.HEAD now reads 5d5d778 in agreement with both the top-level head and live HEAD, the four G12/G21 artifacts that constitute the measurement are added and all measure equal, COORD is refreshed to the live 38297e5b, v3 is recorded at its own digest, and the superseded commit is retained under an explicitly historical key rather than erased. The artifact also hardens against a recurrence, adding G12 v4 and G21 v3 to the remeasurement unmoved-set and stating the invariant 'recordedInputs.HEAD must equal the top-level head', which it satisfies. Every cited digest matches — 25 of 25 pairs across recordedInputs, basedOn and file08Pin, zero mismatches — which is the axis v3 failed on. The measurement itself is untouched: obligations, summary, doesNot, doesNotCloseLeftoverAlone, findingDisposition, proposedLaterWork, liveGateOwners, required-now, file08Pin and head are all == identical to v3, so the eight protected obligations are byte-for-byte unchanged, DR-114 leftover-design is not claimed closed, and nothing is SATISFIED or QUALIFIED. v3 is unmoved at 819b51fb, its version number is not reused, and the subject did not move. I ran four further refutations of my own — that the repair is cosmetic, that the ACCEPT 0/0 claims are overstated, that v4 quietly changed something else, and that the retained historical commit can still be misread — and all four failed against live bytes.
